name: shader-weave
title: Weave
description: Warp and weft threads interlace on a gently warped grid while a slow sheen of light travels across the cloth, drawn in WebGL. An accent color can run through the threads.
useWhen: Tactile, crafted, made-of textures: fabric, mesh, or substrate metaphors.
A scene wants a slow sheen of light traveling across a textured surface.
The brand voice is handcrafted or material rather than digital and smooth.
avoidWhen: You want a smooth gradient field: use shader-mesh-gradient.
You want organic noise instead of a woven structure: use shader-neuro-noise.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Four colors, comma separated: fabric shadow, fabric mid, fabric warm, thread highlight.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Tint carried by the threads (see Accent amount).

variables.label: Accent amount
variables.description: How much of the accent shows, 0 to 1. The original animates it from the host timeline.

variables.label: Warp
variables.description: How hand-woven the threads bend, as a fraction of the frame.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
